_comment: Local few-sample GATHER of KG-context components (rebuttal Task 1). CPU only. AUGMENT emits ONE component file per passage (raw passage + kg_context = kg_rag_*/oracle_* lists with scores); conditions (kg_rag/only_oracle/oracle_pieces/oracle_triples, k, ...) are composed at experiment time by compose_block/GENERATE. See rebuttal_baseline.md CONDITION LADDER + EXPERIMENT_SPACE.

kg_lookup._note: OFF for the core (no snapshot scan). Set true to also gather lookup_triples (existing edges among all oracle entities/relations); then snapshot_dir + snapshot_file_template are required.
